# rancher_secret_backend_service_account (Resource)

Seeds a Rancher service-account token that the engine auto-rotates before Rancher's TTL cap.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Seed a Rancher token the engine will auto-rotate. Rancher caps token TTLs
# (commonly 90d); the engine rotates at rotation_period (default 45d) by minting
# a fresh token with the current one, so the credential never lapses.
resource "rancher_secret_backend_service_account" "admin" {
  backend = rancher_secret_backend.rancher.path
  name    = "admin"

  # The initial token. Write-only: the engine rotates it from here on.
  token = var.rancher_seed_token

  # metadata.name of the seed token, so the first rotation can delete it.
  token_name = var.rancher_seed_token_name

  token_ttl       = 90 * 24 * 3600 # 90d
  rotation_period = 45 * 24 * 3600 # 45d
}

variable "rancher_seed_token" {
  type      = string
  sensitive = true
}

variable "rancher_seed_token_name" {
  type    = string
  default = ""
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `backend` (String) Mount path of the Rancher secrets engine.
- `name` (String) Name of the service account.
- `token` (String, Sensitive) Rancher API token to seed with. Write-only; the engine rotates it from here on and never returns it.

### Optional

- `rotation_period` (Number) Seconds a token is used before rotation (default 45d). Must be less than token_ttl.
- `token_name` (String) ext.cattle.io Token resource name (metadata.name) of the seed token, so the engine can delete it after the first rotation.
- `token_ttl` (Number) Lifetime in seconds requested for each rotated replacement token (default 90d). Must not exceed Rancher's auth-token-max-ttl-minutes.

### Read-Only

- `last_rotated` (String) RFC3339 timestamp of the current token's issuance (computed).

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import by <backend>/service-accounts/<name>. The engine never returns the
# token, so it must still be set in configuration.
terraform import rancher_secret_backend_service_account.admin rancher/service-accounts/admin
```
